blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Adamson snapped a four-game losing streak after beating Ateneo, 62-55, reviving its Final Four hopes in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Precious Jonah, who missed Adamson’s last two games with a right leg injury, immediately made an impact in his return as he finished with 11 points, 17 rebounds, three blocks and two steals. The Falcons improved to 5-7 and moved into a tie with Ateneo for sixth place, and remained 1 1/2 games behind third-running Far Eastern University and La Salle, both […]...
